body: I gently approach the strays, noticing their worn coats and the dullness in their eyes. I think of the shelter we visited last year, wondering if they might find refuge there.
full: I gently approach the strays, noticing their worn coats and the dullness in their eyes. I think of the shelter we visited last year, wondering if they might find refuge there. Next: stay beside them and keep them steady, ready to offer what comfort I can.
